source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Clearly specify the type of emissions that are being observed.
3. Record the volume, concentration, and duration of emissions.
4. Identify the calendar dates, time stamps, and precise location coordinates.
5. Use precise units of measurement (e.g., ppm for concentration, cubic meters for volume).
6. Document weather conditions and other relevant environmental factors that might affect emissions.
7. Include any deviations from standard operating conditions during the time of the excessive emissions.
8. Attach photographs, video footage, or drone imagery as evidence.
9. Use calibrated and certified devices for measurement; note the calibration dates.
10. Include the names, signatures, and qualifications of those who conducted the measurements.
11. Compare the observed emission levels with the permitted emission limits set by regulatory bodies.
12. Discuss any apparent violations of environmental regulations and provide evidence.
13. Summarize the potential health and environmental impacts of the excessive emissions.
